438:t_011:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「...I'll try diving into $n's mind again.」

438:t_011:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「The darkness inside $n runs deep. If things go wrong, you may never return either.」

438:t_011:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「I may not be able to do it alone... But if everyone here joins their strength...!」

438:t_011:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「All right, $$タケル$$. We'll connect everyone's hearts.」

438:t_011:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You understand, $$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$! It's the same as during $$時空修復$$!」

438:t_011:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If we make $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ resonate with the $$ＧＮ粒子$$...!」

438:t_011:8.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$タケル$$... I'll lend you my power.」

438:t_011:10.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「What are you planning, $$マーズ$$?!」

438:t_011:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$... No, $$ズール$$! I... won't fear the darkness!!」

438:t_012:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll dive into $n's mind and wake him up!」

438:t_012:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't know... But during the $$時獄戦役$$, I was able to reach deep inside $$グーラ$$'s mind.」

438:t_012:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「If I can recreate that feeling...!」

438:t_012:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「The darkness inside $n runs deep. If things go wrong, you may never return either.」

438:t_012:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「I may not be able to do it alone... But if everyone here joins their strength...!」

438:t_012:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「All right, $$タケル$$. We'll connect everyone's hearts.」

438:t_012:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You understand, $$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$! It's the same as during $$時空修復$$!」

438:t_012:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If we make $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ resonate with the $$ＧＮ粒子$$...!」

438:t_012:13.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$タケル$$... I'll lend you my power.」

438:t_012:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$... No, $$ズール$$! I... won't fear the darkness!!」

438:t_013:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The hope I told you about... Only your own power can turn it into strength.」

438:t_014:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Impossible! Is this $$スズネ$$'s power?!」

438:t_015:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To truly activate the $$いがみ合う双子$$, you must reconcile opposing emotions and then transcend them...」

438:t_015:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I incorporated the $$ガナリー・カーバー$$'s data into $$ジェニオン$$.」

438:t_015:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now $$ジェニオン$$ should respond to $n's feelings and change its form.」

438:t_015:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I also received data from $$トライア$$ on a system that converts a $$スフィア$$ directly into a weapon...」

438:t_015:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And I gave it a portion of $$ガンレオン$$'s autonomy.」

438:t_015:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「So what the hell does that mean?!」

438:t_015:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ジェニオン$$ will soon be reborn.」

438:t_015:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It will answer $n's will and its own, taking a form that turns the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$'s power more directly into combat strength...」

438:t_015:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In other words, $$ジェニオン$$'s completed form... $$ジェミニオン$$...!」

438:t_016:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A true Diabolus Ex Machina... The birth of the most malevolent machine god, fearing not even God himself.」

438:t_017:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「S-stop, $n! That's enough! You can stop now!!」

438:t_017:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$スフィア$$ won't stop shining...」

438:t_017:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「This is bad! Is it going out of control?!」

438:t_017:4.en:
$n
「I won't cling to convenient hope, or give in to reckless despair. I'll do what I have to do...」

438:t_018:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Tch! This is bad!!」

438:t_020:1.en:
$n
「What's wrong, $$ＡＧ$$? Are you upset because I'm not doing what you wanted?」

438:t_020:3.en:
$n
「You said it yourself. $$ジェニオン$$ would transform in response to my will and its own.」

438:t_020:4.en:
$n
「Even my pilot suit changed. It really thought of everything.」

438:t_020:6.en:
$n
「Don't just give it whatever name you like! This is my fighting strength... I'll name it myself!」

438:t_020:7.en:
$n
「Its name is $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$...! I'll transcend everything, and make this a new beginning!」

438:t_020:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$... It isn't bad.」

438:t_020:10.en:
$n
「Come on, $$アムブリエル$$. I know that wasn't enough to defeat you.」

438:t_021:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$...! Now I want it even more!」

438:t_021:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Stop her and save Miss $$スズネ$$!」

438:t_021:3.en:
$n
「You all gave me strength...! I won't waste it!」
